name: nationwide-sales-distribution-system
description: Monorepo runner for the Nationwide Sales Distribution System (server + client)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --raw -k "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:deploy --prefix server && npm run seed --prefix server
